reason: I can get a bottle of magnesium for a few dollars a month, so $25 to $30 for the same thing in sachets is a lot on my budget. The travel-friendly sachets are nice, but not enough to pay that much more.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And $0.83 a day is way more than what I pay now for magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: A price under about $15 for 30 days, or a flash sale or coupon that brings the first box close to that.
